parameters.query: SELECT n.*, t.symbol, t.entry_price, t.exit_price, t.pnl, t.pnl_pct, t.sl, t.current_target, t.scan_name FROM notifications n JOIN trades t ON t.id = n.trade_id WHERE n.status = 'pending' ORDER BY n.created_at ASC LIMIT 20
UPDATE notifications SET status='sent', sent_at=NOW() WHERE id='{{ $json.id }}'
